coder_notes: Registered as Early Phase 1 (Phase 0/1). Population: recurrent WHO 2021 GBM plus a brain-metastasis group (multi-cancer, so coded basket_gbm_eligible; adjudicator could instead treat as GBM with a separate non-glioma cohort). Expansion to Phase 1 depends on a positive tumour PK response, not on a molecular biomarker. Standard of care for non-responders is mentioned without named drugs.
